props.name: controller
props.description: The controller managing this component's state and behaviour. Bind to it to access the component's imperative API.

props.name: onfirstcreate
props.description: A callback that fires when the component's controller is first created.

props.name: class
props.description: The class names to apply to the deleter's container element. Either a class value, or a function deriving one from the deleter's state.

props.name: children
props.description: The content rendered inside of the deleter.

propsReact.name: onfirstcreate
propsReact.description: A callback that fires when the component's controller is first created.

propsReact.name: className
propsReact.description: The class names to apply to the deleter's container element. Either a class value, or a function deriving one from the deleter's state.

propsReact.name: children
propsReact.description: The child content of the deleter, containing the contents of the deleter button.

properties.name: ref
properties.description: The DOM element bound to this deleter.

properties.name: isHovered
properties.description: Whether the deleter is currently being hovered by the pointer. Prefer this over CSS hover, because it accounts for Flexiboards' keyboard-based pointer.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the deleter's event subscriptions. Adapters call this when the component is destroyed.
